data.plainLyric:
Mm
I think you need a dose of
Vitamin me

찌는 더위, 처진 눈꼬리
잠에 들 것 같은 너, you need some of my citrus
한 방울 튄 맘을 담은 squeeze
고장 난 네 맘을 touch, you'll be like, "Oh"

하나, 둘, 셋, 맘을 refresh, 상큼한 lime juice
I would hate to see you with a gloomy attitude
원하는 색을 맘대로 섞어 단숨에 들이켜
I'll mix it up on a silver platter now
Call it, "Vitamin me"

I'ma make you happy, 달콤한 lemon fizz
Love it like you do, hoo-hoo-hoo-hoo
Got you feeling new, hoo-hoo-hoo-hoo
I'ma make you healthy, 커져가는 heartbeat
밤이 없는 햇빛, yes, me

Got a boost of vitamin me, me
Not A, B, C, vitamin me
Vitamin me, me
Not A, B, C, but you need vitamin me

네 하루를 비출 때, 미지근한 바람은 부족해
'Cause I'm feeling you just come alive
I'm the best pick-me-up that you ever had (ever had)
게으른 네 심장을 뛰게 해 (did that)
네가 바라던 노랠 sing along, like, "Oh-oh, oh"

하나, 둘, 셋, 맘을 refresh, 새빨간 grapefruit
I would hate to see you with a gloomy attitude
원하는 색을 맘대로 섞어 단숨에 들이켜
I'll mix it up on a silver platter now
Call it, "Vitamin me"

I'ma make you happy, 달콤한 lemon fizz
Love it like you do, hoo-hoo-hoo-hoo
Got you feeling new, hoo-hoo-hoo-hoo
I'ma make you healthy, 커져가는 heartbeat
밤이 없는 햇빛, yes, me

Got a boost of vitamin me, me
Not A, B, C, vitamin me
Vitamin me, me
Not A, B, C, but you need vitamin me

너만 비추는 spotlight
아무도 몰래 내 손을 잡아
Maybe, maybe you've changed me, changed me now
너라면 뭐든지, 난

한여름의 dreamy, 차오르는 sparkling (yeah)
Love it like you do, hoo-hoo-hoo-hoo (yeah)
Got you feeling new, hoo-hoo-hoo-hoo
싱그러운 wavy (oh), 커져가는 heartbeat (ha)
밤이 없는 햇빛, yes, me

Not A, B, C, vitamin me (vitamin, vitamin me)
(Oh) vitamin me, me (vitamin, vitamin me)
Not A, B, C (vitamin, vitamin), but you need vitamin me
